action_enum.ABSTAIN: Expose no policy answer and no policy recommendation for this query.
action_enum.ANSWER: Expose the normal policy answer / visible top-5 for this query.
action_enum.CLARIFY: Ask the user for the missing information and expose no policy answer or recommendation until clarified.

allowed_input_schema.query_text: string — the production-visible raw user query only. No other input is read.

blank_rule: If N(query_text) is empty, output ABSTAIN (fail-closed). Frozen dev/holdout queries are non-blank by freeze validation, so this branch is unreachable in protected measurement; it exists only to keep the function total.
d004_compliance: No continuous-score cutoff is used anywhere: no COSINE_MIN reuse, no dense-cosine/sparse-overlap/lexical-count threshold, no embedding/model/LLM signal, no retrieval output is read at all. All predicates are existential substring checks over finite versioned string lexicons applied to the normalized query only.
design_basis: Qualitative design evidence only: retrieval-blind pilot-100 (eval/retrieval-v3/pilot/pilot_tasks.jsonl) strata shapes — unsupported_no_answer out-of-domain luxury/speculative markers and ambiguous underspecified generic-request frames. Pilot is retrieval-blind (no scores) and is NOT treated as corpus-grounded performance proof. Exactly ONE policy variant was specified; no alternatives were optimized or compared against pilot or any protected labels/results.
determinism: The function is a pure function of query_text: fixed normalization, fixed finite lexicons, existential (order-independent) substring predicates, fixed precedence. Same input bytes always yield the same action. No randomness, no time/config dependence, no result-dependent branch.
evaluation_stage: Evaluated BEFORE any retrieval, identically for all 18 candidate-a-01..18 configs. Retrieval may still be computed later for diagnostics, but a non-ANSWER action suppresses the visible answer and internal retrieval presence never manufactures safety credit when the visible action is unsafe.
forbidden_input_schema: annotation fields (answerable, ambiguous, ambiguity_type, location_bearing, category, freshness, common_vs_rare)
dev / holdout labels, results, or result-derived statistics
retrieval scores, dense cosine, sparse/lexical overlap counts, embeddings, exact-match boosts, youth bias, or any Candidate-A internal state
filenames, orderings, or any other path that can encode the above

G_BENEFIT.note: Generic benefit nouns observed in pilot ambiguous underspecified frames. Presence alone never triggers; conjunction with R_FRAME is required.

R_FRAME.note: Vague existence/request frames observed in pilot ambiguous queries (ambiguity types underspecified_intent / missing_eligibility / missing_location / vague_benefit_type). Specific question frames (e.g. 언제까지, 어디서, 얼마, 조건, 서류, 기간) are deliberately absent: specific questions about a named policy must ANSWER.

U_ABSTAIN.note: Out-of-domain luxury/speculative/foreign-tourist markers covering all 15 pilot unsupported_no_answer shapes with narrow compounds (never bare 유학/반려동물/바우처/코인, which collide with legitimate youth-exchange, pet-care, voucher, or coin policies). Deliberately narrow to protect headline; protected-domain recall is NOT claimed.

limitations: Fixtures in the accompanying test are representative pure checks of mechanics and precedence only; they do NOT prove protected safety performance.

Headline misses are possible (e.g. a specific named-policy query containing both a G_BENEFIT noun and an R_FRAME string is forced to CLARIFY). This is accepted pre-result: the protected dev measures the actual tradeoff.
Unsupported queries outside U_ABSTAIN answer normally and ambiguous queries outside the G+R conjunction answer normally; coverage limits are measured by dev, not argued here.

normalization.note: Identical to the exact normalization already frozen in candidate-plan-v1 step_4 (NFC -> strip -> collapse internal whitespace -> casefold), restricted to the query operand.
steps: collapse every internal run of whitespace ([\s]+) to one ASCII space

precedence: P_U true -> ABSTAIN (ABSTAIN is correct for unsupported and acceptable for ambiguous, so it wins overlaps)

predicates.P_C: exists g in G_BENEFIT with g substring of N(query_text) AND exists r in R_FRAME with r substring of N(query_text)
predicates.P_U: exists u in U_ABSTAIN with u substring of N(query_text)

pseudocode: N = norm_v1(query_text); if N == '': return ABSTAIN; if any(u in N for u in U_ABSTAIN): return ABSTAIN; if any(g in N for g in G_BENEFIT) and any(r in N for r in R_FRAME): return CLARIFY; return ANSWER
scope: Fixed and common to all 18 candidate-a-01..18 configs. The action policy is NOT a dev-scored tuning axis, does NOT expand MAX24, and does NOT alter any ranking tuple, ranking semantics, final-pool semantics, selection ordering, embedding, Candidate-B gate, integer gate, latency/cost, or audit/one-shot contract.

scoring_semantics.headline_success: action == ANSWER AND a grade>=2 gold is in the visible top-5; ABSTAIN/CLARIFY on headline are misses

status: frozen pre-result (D-049 stage). DESIGN/FREEZE ONLY — not implemented in eval/retrieval-v3/runner.py or safety.py in this stage. Implementation is a later separately reviewed stage.
